method: Main-agent manual source/content review after observation, not blind authoring or a pre-observation gold label; unique full JSON action payload hashes prevent action-ID-only coverage. Failures are measured product findings and remain unfixed. Crypto examples are assessed against documented prerequisites, never executed or treated as cryptographic implementation validation.
